name: Tide Explorer
description: You just pulled on your fins. The shallows are your classroom.
briefing: Welcome, ranger! Watch, wonder, and be gentle. Every fish has a story. Your Marinepedia grows with every discovery.

name: Reef Scout
description: You know the coral city and its colorful neighbors.
briefing: Reefs are cities built by tiny animals. Clean water and careful divers keep them bright. You are learning to care for the reef.

name: Kelp Keeper
description: You clean as you explore and free what gets stuck.
briefing: Litter and lost nets hurt animals that cannot ask for help. Your cleanups and rescues matter. Keep going, Keeper.

name: Abyss Ranger
description: You respect the deep and the strange life that lives there.
briefing: The deep ocean is Earth's last great wilderness. Light is rare, and life is clever. Rangers protect what they barely know yet.

name: Ocean Guardian
description: Legendary helper of the blue planet.
briefing: You lead with curiosity and kindness. Teach a friend one ocean fact. Guardians share knowledge — that is how oceans heal.
